name: grimmsnarl_ml_v6
deck_note: Unchanged from v1-v6: the exact 60-card Grimmsnarl list used by the selected corpus.
model_note: Byte-identical to grimmsnarl_ml_v5: the same refreshed 2000-tree team-conditioned ranker, 823 features, 4,097 games, 322,975 decisions, 21 teams. v6 changes which pilot the model is asked about on one decision class, not the weights.
rules_note: fallback_policy.py, ml_planner.py, ml_features.py and policy_base.py are byte-identical to v5, including the v5 Punk Up and Buddy-Buddy Poffin search budgets and all five planner dominance rules.

policy_escalation.code_source: Dense 0..20 code from sorted team ids in corpus_v5_data_refresh_candidate.npz; asserted in tests/test_v6_teacher_escalation.py.
policy_escalation.rationale: The deployed pin 16494330 has the highest Froslass evolve rate of the 21 pilots in the corpus (95.7% of the turns it is offered, against 52.6% in the mirror for 16371703). v5 plays it on 59 of 59 offered turns, so the behaviour is faithful imitation of an outlier rather than a modelling error, and three previous versions failed to move a MAIN preference with feature columns. A MAIN select that offers the Froslass evolve is therefore scored end to end as pilot 16371703; every other decision keeps the pin.
policy_escalation.scope_note: One teacher code per argmax. The pin's answer on the escalated decisions is also computed, purely so the deployed change rate is a counted number in diag_snapshot rather than an assumption.

policy: v5's search budgets and one-ply planner are unchanged. MAIN and the other routed single-pick contexts use the refreshed 2000-tree team-conditioned ranker pinned to 16494330, except that a MAIN select offering a Froslass evolve is scored as 16371703. Low-support context 8 remains on the rule policy. Multi-pick selects and face-down prize picks remain with the marnies_grimmsnarl_ex_v7 rule policy.

stored_board_validation.global_pin_rejected_because: Pinning every context to 16371703 reproduces the same Froslass numbers but changes 712 decisions and drops the Grimmsnarl ex evolve from 81/130 to 56/130, Boss from 42/118 to 28/118, and the best-prize Bench-30 kill from 52/52 to 51/52.

mirror_versus_v5.note: Read for safety and timing only; 299 paired mirror games could not separate v5 from v4.

live_escalation_rate.note: Higher than the teacher-forced 1.52% because refusing the evolve leaves the Snorunt benched with the Froslass in hand, so the class re-fires on later turns.

description: v6 keeps every v5 behaviour and swaps the teacher for one decision class. The v5 ladder run met all six of its pre-registered resource targets and left the Froslass over-evolve at 100% of offered turns; that behaviour is the deployed pin's own policy, so v6 asks the 1220.2-rated pilot about that class instead of adding a rule or a feature.
